page_title: ANG 0-1 LEN | Angers v Lens 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Thomas Leonard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Jordan Lefort (Angers) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
90' The referee signals a substitution. Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) is brought on as a substitute for Florian Sotoca.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' Rough tackle by Ruben Aguilar (Lens). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Angers, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
79' Substitution. Pierrick Capelle leaves the pitch and is replaced by Zinedine Ould Khaled (Angers).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ibrahima Niane (Angers) will replace Sidiki Cherif.
76' Here is a change. Carlens Arcus is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers).
76' The substitution has been made. Florent Hanin (Angers) has replaced Jacques Ekomie.
76' Deiver Machado (Lens) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
76' Flag goes up against Sidiki Cherif (Angers) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
72' Will Still has decided to make a change. Andy Diouf (Lens) replaces Nampalys Mendy.
72' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Wesley Said will be replaced by Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens).
70' That's the end of the game for Yassine Belkhdim, who is replaced by Lois Diony (Angers).
68' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Sidiki Cherif (Angers) heads on.
66' Yahia Fofana leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Deiver Machado (Lens).
65' Will Still prepares a substitution. Jhoanner Chavez is replaced by Deiver Machado (Lens).
65' Substitution. David Pereira da Costa (Lens) on for Angelo Fulgini.

62' The game is interrupted. Jonathan Gradit (Lens) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Angers get a free kick.
58' Jordan Lefort (Angers) sees a yellow card from Thomas Leonard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
58' Dangerous play by Wesley Said (Lens). Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul. Angers are awarded a free kick.
54' The corner kick from Pierrick Capelle (Angers) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
53' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Angers have a corner.
50' Facundo Medina (Lens) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
46' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The corner from Pierrick Capelle (Angers) is intercepted by the defence.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Wesley Said (Lens) sends a rebound from close range to the right post.

43' Post! Florian Sotoca (Lens) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the centre of the box wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the right post!
40' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Angers are awarded the free kick.
37' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Leonard blows for a foul. Free kick. Lens will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
34' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is able to continue to play.
34' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
33' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
31' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' 0 - 1 Wesley Said (Lens) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
28' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lens.
28' Pierrick Capelle (Angers) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
27' Himad Abdelli (Angers) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

27' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) latched on to a cross into the box and headed the ball under the crossbar. A decent header but it lacked power, allowing the goalkeeper to make a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Angers.
26' Wesley Said (Lens) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header low towards the middle of the goal, but Yahia Fofana is alert and denies him.
25' Thomas Leonard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jonathan Gradit (Lens) and blew his whistle. Angers have a free kick.
23' Wesley Said (Lens) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
23' Brice Samba comes off his line to intercept the corner from Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
20' Himad Abdelli (Angers) takes the corner but it's cleared.
18' The linesman signals that Sidiki Cherif (Angers) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
16' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
13' The free kick is delivered by Sidiki Cherif (Angers) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
13' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul. A free kick to Angers.
13' Himad Abdelli (Angers) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
12' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
10' The referee blows his whistle as Ruben Aguilar (Lens) was too aggressive in his challenge. Angers will take a free kick near the side line.
9' Poor challenge! Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) is penalised for tripping and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle. Lens win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
5' Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Lens are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
2' A goal, which was scored by Florian Sotoca (Lens), was disallowed due to offside.
1' It looks like Jordan Lefort (Angers) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Leonard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Lens.
1' The first half has just begun.
Angers will kick the game off.
Thomas Leonard will referee today's match.
